image_description: A close-up portrait of a mature male orangutan resting its chin on its folded arms atop a rock. The subject features characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and prominent cheek pads (flanges). The background consists of blurred rocks and foliage, with out-of-focus green leaves in the immediate foreground creating a depth-of-field effect.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the foreground leaves and the orangutan's fur. AI generators often struggle with depth-of-field blur interacting with complex hair textures. Verify if the 'blur' looks optical or like a smearing artifact. Also, check the symmetry of the cheek pads; asymmetry can indicate warping.
